newsitem.title: CHINA: China punishes "model worker" for embezzlement.
newsitem.headline: China punishes "model worker" for embezzlement.

text.p: China has punished a Communist Party official -- once hailed as a model worker -- for embezzling 570,000 yuan ($68,700), the China News Service said on Wednesday.
The Communist Party's Beijing Disciplinary Committee had recently stripped Chen Ming, general manager and party secretary of the Beijing Electronic Power Co, of his party membership, the agency said.
Chen had embezzled a total of 570,000 yuan from his company by channelling the funds through a fraudulent equipment firm he set up, it said.

Chen had been previously honoured as a national "model worker" and had received the same accolade from Beijing city, it said, adding that the committee recommended that he be stripped of those titles.
China bestows model worker status on people it believes embody traditional communist ethics of self-sacrifice and hard work.
The committee had also stripped Chen of his membership in the local people's congress and legal departments were looking into Chen's other financial problems, it said without elaborating.
Corruption has become rampant in China as market-oriented reforms and the rise of a quick-profit mentality provide new opportunities for abuse of official power.
Beijing has vowed to fight official graft, warning it could eventually topple party rule.
